name: @keiya-dev/japan-used-camera-mcp

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Lists the markets this server covers (used cameras, used watches) with each market's shop ids, condition grades (best to worst), price-history coverage and example keywords. Free and instant — call it first when unsure which sources / grades are valid.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search current used listings at Japanese shops — cameras / lenses (Fujiya Camera, Sanpou Camera, Naniwa new arrivals, Hard Off Off Mall) or wristwatches (WATCHNIAN, Hard Off Off Mall). Returns title, brand, normalized condition grade, price in JPY and USD, stock status and URL; watches add reference number, gender and box / warranty card (WATCHNIAN). Takes ~15–60 s.

market.description: Which market: "camera" (used cameras and lenses) or "watch" (used wristwatches). Default "camera". Shops and grades depend on it — see list_markets.

keywords.description: Match any of these in brand + title (case-insensitive, English or Japanese; watches also match reference numbers), e.g. ["Leica M6"] or ["Grand Seiko", "SBGA211"].

brands.description: Exact brand names, e.g. ["Leica", "Nikon"] or ["Rolex", "Grand Seiko"].

sources.description: Shops of the chosen market (default: all of them). camera: fujiya, sanpou, naniwa, hardoff; watch: watchnian, offmall.

grades.description: Normalized condition grades of the chosen market, best to worst. camera: NEW > A > AB+ > AB > AB- > B > ASIS (as is) > PARTS; watch: NEW > UNUSED > SA (like new) > A > AB > B > C > JUNK (not working); ANTIQUE = ungraded antique.

includeSoldOut.description: Also return listings marked sold out.

maxItems.description: Stop after this many matching listings (1–200).

tools.name: price_stats
tools.description: Per-model price summary of in-stock listings right now: count and min / median / max (JPY and USD), broken down by shop and by normalized condition grade, plus the cheapest listing. Watches are grouped by brand + reference number. Use keywords to stay fast (~1–4 min).

maxItems.description: Listings to read before summarizing (0 = all; a full read of every shop can take 5–30 min).

tools.name: price_history
tools.description: Daily min / median / max / count per model, by shop and condition grade, from stored snapshots of the shops (camera: Daily since 2026-11-05 for fujiya, sanpou, naniwa; hardoff weekly (Sundays). watch: Daily since 2026-11-05 for watchnian; offmall weekly (Sundays). The first month is short). No crawling — returns in seconds. Needs keywords, brands or models.

tools.name: start_monitor
tools.description: Creates, in the user's own Apify account, a saved Task running the market's Actor in monitor mode and a Schedule for it (hourly by default), then starts the first run to record the baseline. Later runs emit only changes (NEW / PRICE_DROP / PRICE_UP / SOLD_OUT) and can POST them to a Slack / Discord / n8n webhook. This creates resources and recurring runs that use the user's Apify credit — confirm with the user first.

alertWebhookUrl.description: Slack / Discord incoming webhook or any URL that accepts a JSON POST.

alertEvents.description: Event types to output and send. Default: NEW and PRICE_DROP.

cron.description: Cron expression for the Schedule (default hourly). Please not more often than every 15 minutes.
